Terms of Use

Use these tools only with documents you are authorized to process. Keep original copies and inspect the generated files before submission, publication or other important use.

PDF operations may invalidate signatures or alter forms, links, text selection or layout. A drawn signature is a visual overlay, not a digital certificate or identity check. Cropping, overlays and metadata clearing are not secure redaction. The site does not promise compatibility with every PDF, guaranteed availability or fitness for a particular purpose.
